capabilities: Intercept UI text from core commands, context menus, settings panels and the DOM
Translate text via OpenAI-compatible, DeepL, Google Cloud Translation, Azure or custom endpoints
Cache translations locally with usage and cost statistics
Translate community plugin marketplace entries on demand
Control scope with per-plugin whitelists, blacklists, skip regexes and a glossary
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly); never translates user content such as the note editor, file names or search excerpts; API keys are encrypted via Electron safeStorage in secrets.bin and should not be synced across devices.
motivation: The author built it so users get localized UI without waiting for plugin authors to localize their plugins.
problem: Obsidian's community plugin ecosystem is mostly English-only and localization depends on each plugin author choosing to translate their own plugin.
